articles.title: Crows can evaluate visual info twice as fast as mammals
articles.summary:
Much of what we know about how a brain makes decisions comes from studying monkeys watching dots. In a task known as a random-dot-motion task, a cloud of flickering specks drifts weakly in one direction while the subject tries to determine whether—and in which direction— it’s moving. The task has shown that in the primate neocortex, neurons gather visual evidence over time, with their firing rates climbing until they cross a threshold, when the animal commits to a decision.
But avian brains don’t have a neocortex, so it wasn’t obvious how they made similar decisions.
“This was the big question,” said Andreas Nieder, a neurobiologist at the University of Tübingen. “How [would] a differently organized avian brain encode decisions?”
To find out, Nieder and his colleague Philipp Schmidbauer put two carrion crows through the same task the monkeys faced, recording their brain activity along the way. The crows solved the task the same way primates do, using the same mathematical logic despite having a very different brain structure. And they did it two times faster.
A brain built different
Nieder and Schmidbauer put two hand-raised crows in front of a touch-sensitive monitor showing a cloud of white dots on black, with some fraction of them drifting coherently left or right or up or down. The birds’ job was to report the overall direction by pecking one of the targets that flanked the display. Correct answers earned them a mealworm.

“Cualquier acceso o uso del contenido de nuestros miembros con fines de inteligencia artificial sin su permiso expreso por escrito es contrario a la ley vigente”, escribió la ejecutiva en la carta dirigida al director ejecutivo de Meta, Mark Zuckerberg.
El reclamo llega después de que Nieman Lab revelara el 15 de octubre que los nuevos términos comerciales de Meta permitían a la empresa rastrear con bots los sitios de cualquier cuenta empresarial en Facebook, Instagram, WhatsApp o Threads, y usar ese contenido para entrenar sus productos de inteligencia artificial. Dos días después, la empresa eliminó la palabra “entrenar” del texto y acotó los usos permitidos a productos de publicidad y de negocios.

articles.title: L'intensité du typhon champi a un coupable tout désigné : El Niño
articles.summary:
Vu de l’espace, le typhon Champi, qui balaie Taïwan ce vendredi 23 octobre, présente une structure quasiment circulaire.
Au plus fort de sa course au-dessus de la mer des Philippines, ce mercredi 21 octobre, ses rafales dépassaient les 300 km/h. Il s’est depuis nettement affaibli et ne devrait pas toucher terre directement. À l’approche de Taïwan, l’Administration météorologique centrale de l’île relevait ce vendredi des vents soutenus de 155 km/h, avec des rafales d’environ 191 km/h près de son centre.
L’île est quasiment à l’arrêt ce vendredi, avec la plupart des écoles, des bureaux et des commerces fermés, tout comme la Bourse de Taïwan. Les habitants sont appelés à rester chez eux et plus de 1 200 personnes ont été évacuées. Côté transports, des centaines de vols sont annulés, dont la totalité des 262 vols intérieurs prévus ce vendredi.
Les vagues soulevées par le typhon ont déjà fait un mort, jeudi sur l’île de Liuqiu, et les autorités comptent 94 blessés. Bien que le typhon s’affaiblisse, on attend jusqu’à 900 millimètres de pluie entre jeudi et samedi dans les régions montagneuses du nord et du nord-est de l’île.
L’eau chaude : ingrédient principal du typhon
Si ce typhon est aussi intense, le phénomène El Niño, installé cette année dans le Pacifique, a pu y contribuer. Pour le comprendre, il faut revenir à la manière dont se forment les typhons.

La propuesta, que fue publicada en un comunicado oficial del organismo, incorpora a la biotecnología dentro del Programa de Seguridad de Inversión Saliente, un mecanismo creado en 2023 que hasta ahora restringía la inversión estadounidense en semiconductores, inteligencia artificial y computación cuántica dentro de países considerados adversarios.
El Tesoro definió a los “compuestos farmacéuticos” como una “tecnología prohibida”, una categoría que bloquea de forma directa ciertas transacciones con la nación asiática y otros países señalados, entre ellos Rusia, Irán, Corea del Norte y Cuba.

“Las regulaciones propuestas fortalecerían el programa existente para evitar que nuestros adversarios usen la inversión estadounidense para desarrollar tecnologías críticas que amenazan la seguridad nacional”, afirmó el secretario del Tesoro, Scott Bessent.

articles.title: Inside the Pentagon, the pressure is on to find a home for a new spaceport
articles.summary:
Leaders in the US Space Force would like to have a new spaceport up and running in four years, adding a third heavy-lift launch site to relieve pressure from bases in Florida and California that have shot rockets into orbit for nearly 70 years.
The obvious problem with that ambition is 2030 is four years away, and Pentagon officials have not determined where the new spaceport should go or how to acquire land for it.
Air Force Secretary Troy Meink first mentioned the service’s search for a third launch base in May. A congressionally mandated study of the Space Force’s launch infrastructure identified the need for “another site that’s capable of heavy and super heavy launch capability,” Meink said in a House Armed Services Committee hearing.
The Trump administration released a space transportation policy in August that endorsed the construction of more launch and reentry sites for commercial and military missions. This week, the Space Force general responsible for procuring launch services for the military laid out an “aspirational” timeline for a new launch site.
“We need this capability by 2030, but I’m also a pragmatist,” said Lt. Gen. Philip Garrant, head of Space Systems Command. “That is not an inconsequential demand to build a spaceport when you factor in orbital regimes, safety, access to commodities, the Americans that live near it. In many ways, it’s much like an airport, but even louder. So there’s a lot of consideration.”

El modelo ya está disponible para todos los usuarios de Canva a nivel mundial desde la pestaña Dream Lab del menú de la aplicación, según informó la empresa en un comunicado publicado en su sala de prensa.
También puede usarse a través de la API pública de Canva, pensada para que desarrolladores integren la herramienta en plataformas de marketing, comercio electrónico o sitios de impresión.
Craft genera imágenes de hasta 2.000 píxeles de resolución en más de 30 proporciones de aspecto distintas. Canva explicó que el sistema funciona en dos etapas: primero interpreta el pedido del usuario y arma un plan de composición que define qué elementos aparecen, su escala, su jerarquía visual y el texto que debe incluirse; después, un segundo modelo traduce ese plan en la imagen final.
Esa arquitectura en dos pasos busca resolver un problema habitual de los generadores de imágenes: el texto ilegible o mal ubicado dentro de la composición. Según la empresa, separar la planificación del renderizado permite un control más preciso sobre cada elemento, de modo que se puede editar una parte de la imagen sin alterar el resto.

Product-market fit — when a startup’s product sells well — has become even harder to find in this AI era. Despite startups achieving record-fast growth, not all customers are sticky and products can be replicated more easily than ever.

Right now, she said, a lot of founders pitch revenue metrics to investors without specifying which revenue they are talking about. “Is it true ARR or is it run rate?” she said. “There’s many ways to obfuscate the whole thing.”

Die Bundesregierung plant die “digitale Brieftasche” für alle. Für die “d-you” genannte Wallet hat sie Mitte Oktober die gesetzlichen Grundlagen geschaffen, der Bundesrat muss noch zustimmen.
Starten soll die App bereits zum 2.Januar 2027. Damit setzt Deutschland Vorgaben aus der EU um. D-you ist also die deutsche Version der European Digital Identity Wallet (EUDI-Wallet), entwickelt wird sie von SPRIND und Common Codes im Auftrag des vom Bundesministerium für Digitales und Staatsmodernisierung (BMDS).
Die Nutzung ist freiwillig. Wer kein Smartphone hat oder das digitale Angebot einfach nicht nutzen will, kann also weiter auf die physischen Ausweisdokumente zurückgreifen. Nutzen lässt sich d-you ab 16 Jahren und nur auf einem Smartphone mit NFC und Android oder iOS, alternative Betriebssysteme werden nicht unterstützt. Außerdem braucht die Ausweisfunktion eine Internetverbindung. Geht das Handy verloren, muss die Wallet ohne Backup komplett neu eingerichtet werden.
Behörden, die für ihre Online-Dienste einen elektronischen Ausweis verlangen, müssen d-you als Identifizierungsdienst akzeptieren. Ab Ende 2027 sind dann auch Banken, Energieversorger, Telekommunikationsanbieter und sehr große Online-Plattformen verpflichtet, die Wallet zu nutzen. Media hora sin desayunar, sin café, sin tomar ninguna otra medicación. Y todo eso para que un 1-2% de la semaglutida oral que ha tomado llegue a la sangre.
Durante años, la mejor pastilla que teníamos para perder peso era el Rybelsus y tomarlo, como vemos, requería una disciplina casi monacal. Es decir, la biodisponibilidad acaba por ser limitada y a poca gente le iba realmente bien.

¿Qué ha pasado exactamente? El Comité de Medicamentos de Uso Humano de la Agencia Europea del Medicamento ha dado su visto bueno para dos usos del orforglipron: el control de peso y la diabetes tipo 2 mal controlada. Es verdad que el Comité no puede aprobar medicamentos (eso lo hace la Comisión), pero a efectos prácticos es el paso previo clave.

With its Xtacking 4.0 technology, YMTC can separate memory cell wafers from peripheral logic circuits and combine them using hybrid bonding wafer-to-wafer stacking. Hybrid bonding creates a permanent bond between two silicon chips using embedded metal bumps that are fused together to form a single chip. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth issued a memo warning military personnel against using nonpublic information to make bets on prediction markets, saying the wagers could give important clues to enemy countries.
“Do Not Compromise Military Operations for Personal Financial Gain,” said the subject line of an October 20 memo published yesterday by CBS News. Hegseth’s memo was sent to senior Pentagon leadership, Combatant Command leaders, and Defense Department field activity directors.
Hegseth wrote:
Our enemies watch movements in these markets. When an American Service member, intelligence professional, or other Department civilian engages in a financial transaction on a military outcome, they create a signal. That signal can be aggregated, correlated, and exploited by hostile foreign intelligence services to anticipate our movements, targets, and timing. The lives of our Service members often depend on the enemy not knowing what is coming. The men and women who carry our flag into harm’s way deserve a Force that protects them—not one that exposes them to the enemy for personal gain.

The global shortage of memory chips has driven up costs, placing a huge strain on electric vehicle makers in the country.
Bengaluru-based Ultraviolette—which produces high-performance electric motorcycles—says it will not pass on the high input costs to customers and is exploring other ways to tide over the situation.
Memory chips are a critical component of an electric vehicle, used to store data, run control software, and manage real-time operations across critical systems.
According to Ultraviolette’s Founder and CTO, Niraj Rajmohan, RAM (random access memory) alone adds Rs 20,000 to the cost of a vehicle. With global companies building very large data centres, there has been a surge in memory chip consumption, he added.
AI data centres are projected to consume 70% of global memory chip production in 2026. The data centre boom has led to a supply crunch, subsequently shoring up costs of chips.
But it would not be fair to pass on the costs to customers, said Rajmohan, adding that a threefold jump in memory prices in recent times cannot translate into a threefold jump in the price of an electric bike, and customers cannot be asked to suddenly pay far more.

Venture capital funding during the week stood at just $96 million across 15 deals. In contrast, startups raised a total of $180 million in the previous week.
This sharp drop in venture capital funding highlights the challenges the Indian startup ecosystem continues to face in raising a steady flow of capital. This is also the eighth time so far this year that weekly venture capital funding has fallen below the $100 million mark.
The only large deal during the week was Even Healthcare’s $50 million raise. The other deals were worth $11 million or less. While transactions during the week saw investors place their bets across segments such as healthcare, consumer and AI, there were no other significant deals.
The biggest challenge for the Indian startup ecosystem so far this year has been the low number of large-value deals. In fact, there have been just 16 deals worth $100 million or more. This does not bode well for the ecosystem as 2026 draws to a close.

articles.title: 300 glaciares han desaparecido del oeste americano desde mediados del siglo XX. Los supervivientes tienen algunas cosas en común
articles.summary:
Nuestros paisajes están cambiando radicalmente con el paso de los años, y las altas cumbres estadounidenses no han sido una excepción, puesto que el oeste de Estados Unidos siempre ha sido un referente por la cantidad de glaciares con los que cuenta. Y hablamos en pasado porque un artículo publicado en la revista PNAS apunta a que ya se ha perdido aproximadamente una cuarta parte de los glaciares.
Un inventario. Para entender exactamente lo que está ocurriendo aquí, los científicos se han apoyado en comparar los mapas topográficos históricos del Servicio Geológico de los Estados Unidos, elaborados con fotografías aéreas tomadas entre 1955 y 1990, con el inventario más reciente finalizado en 2015. Aunque obviamente no todo lo que se ve es glaciar, puesto que para los expertos ganarse esta distinción requiere que estemos ante una masa perenne de nieve e hielo en constante movimiento.
Y a simple vista, las cifras netas podrían llegar a confusión, puesto que los mapas antiguos registraban 1453 glaciares, mientras que el inventario más reciente contabiliza 1.331 glaciares. Aquí la confusión es que, aunque a priori parece que se han perdido 122 glaciares, la realidad es que han desaparecido 300 glaciares.
¿Por qué? La respuesta a esta discrepancia está en la fragmentación, puesto que a medida que los grandes glaciares menguan por el calor, muchos se parten en pedazos más pequeños, inflando artificialmente el número de glaciares individuales a pesar de que la cantidad total de hielo…

articles.title: How to avoid AI's 'valley of despair' - SiliconANGLE
articles.summary:
How to avoid AI’s ‘valley of despair’
Amdahl’s Law states that improving a single part of a system can only speed up the whole system so much. Even if one step of a process becomes exponentially faster, the other steps impose a ceiling unless they, too, are accelerated.
This concept may explain some of the disappointment companies are experiencing with artificial intelligence. An AI assistant can draft a proposal in seconds, but it then sits for days waiting on reviews, pricing and approval. Similarly, a coding tool can produce software in minutes, but testing, security and deployment still take days or weeks.
Companies have accelerated specific tasks without reengineering the systems that surround them. This gap between inflated expectations and modest returns is what some are calling AI’s “valley of despair.”
After a period of vigorous adoption and experimentation, executives are now being confronted with ever-growing costs and limited proof of bottom-line impact. Analyst firm Forrester Research Inc. recently found that only 15% of AI decision-makers reported an increase in earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization over the past 12 months. Fewer than one-third could clearly map the value of AI back to bottom-line changes.
This skepticism is healthy; AI investments should face the same scrutiny as any other capital expense. Leaders need to be clear on expected returns, timelines and milestones that show whether their investment delivers measurable busine…

Se multiplican. Tal y como comparten desde National Geographic, una excavación de salvamento en los meses previos al verano de 2025 sacó a la luz unas 15 tumbas. In AI, it’s a tale of two diverging investor classes
Depending on where you sit as an investor, artificial intelligence still looks like a massive opportunity, or it’s now looking way too risky given growing infrastructure investments and the public’s souring on AI and all the data centers needed to power it.
Really, it’s both. This week saw continued big venture capital investments in AI companies such as OpenAI, DeepSeek, Legora, Otter.ai, Flapping Airplanes (really) and more. But on Thursday, continued worry about potentially excessive data center spending — such as at Meta, which plans to issue new shares to pay for even more expansion — knocked AI stocks such as SpaceX and CoreWeave way down Thursday.

Les terres rares forment un groupe de 17 métaux. Dans la croûte terrestre, elles sont dispersées, mélangées entre elles, et très difficiles à extraire comme à séparer. Un domaine dans lequel la Chine a pris une avance monumentale : selon l’Agence internationale de l’énergie (AIE), elle assurait en 2024 environ 60 % de l’extraction mondiale des terres rares, ainsi que 91 % de leur raffinage et 94 % de la production d’aimants. Un atout économique qui peut devenir une véritable arme diplomatique.
Un levier redoutable pour la Chine
Car ces métaux offrent une puissance environ dix fois supérieure à celle des aimants classiques, pour un poids et une taille réduits. On les retrouve donc partout : dans les smartphones, les voitures électriques, les éoliennes, les avions de chasse ou encore les moteurs des machines d’usine.
Et justement, d’après Reuters, TSMC, numéro 1 mondial de la fabrication de semi-conducteurs, a sondé ses fournisseurs sur des moteurs sans terres rares pour l’automatisation de ses usines. Car aujourd’hui, ils fonctionnent grâce à des aimants fabriqués à partir de ces métaux. Une initiative qui fait suite aux larges restrictions imposées par la Chine ces dernières années.

La novela corta “Donde el agua trabaja”, del escritor peruano David Silva Rojas, fue escrita en un 99% por inteligencia artificial, según el detector Pangram. La obra había ganado en julio el primer Premio Internacional de Novela Breve Almadía Ventosa-Arrufat, dotado con 20.000 euros, según informó este viernes el diario español El País.
El hallazgo llevó a la editorial mexicana Almadía a suspender la presentación del libro prevista para este viernes en Madrid, así como el resto de la gira por Barcelona, Sevilla y Cádiz. El País calificó el caso como el primero de este calibre detectado en la literatura en español.
El premio fue convocado en noviembre de 2025 por Almadía junto a la fundación española Ventosa-Arrufat. Las bases eran explícitas: la participación implicaba declarar que la obra no había sido escrita, ni parcial ni totalmente, con herramientas de inteligencia artificial, bajo pena de descalificación en cualquier fase del proceso.
Entre 2.204 manuscritos enviados desde 22 países, el jurado eligió por unanimidad la novela de Silva Rojas, abogado e investigador de 45 años nacido en Ica. Lo integraron la escritora mexicana Cristina Rivera Garza, la argentina Selva Almada y la ecuatoriana Mónica Ojeda, quienes destacaron “el uso de los silencios” y un lenguaje de oraciones breves que evitaba “la tentación del panfleto”.

Or, ces infrastructures fonctionnent grâce au réseau électrique classique, lourdement chahuté par les intempéries. JPMorgan, Bank of America, Wells Fargo, Morgan Stanley y Citi están adoptando medidas para restringir el acceso de estas herramientas, ante las dificultades para distinguir la actividad de una persona de la de un sistema automatizado. El problema plantea nuevos interrogantes sobre la seguridad del dinero y la responsabilidad por las operaciones no autorizadas.

Sony Retires Its Last 4K Blu-ray Player in Japan, PS5 Is All That's Left
Sony has stopped shipping the UBP-X700/K in Japan, its last standalone 4K Ultra HD Blu-ray player in the country. Shipments ended on October 22, and according to Sony retailer Kunkoku, the remaining stock on Sony's Japanese store sold out almost immediately. There's no word on a successor. That leaves the disc-equipped PlayStation 5 as the only Sony product in Japan that can still play 4K Blu-ray movies. The UBP-X700/K only launched on May 17, 2025, as a cut-down version of the 2018 UBP-X700 without streaming apps, and it was last listed at ¥58,300. Sony will keep selling the BDP-S1700/K, though that one only handles regular Blu-ray discs.
The PS5 is not a perfect stand-in for home theater enthusiasts either. It handles 4K Blu-ray with HDR10, but it lacks Dolby Vision support, which the UBP-X700/K offered. Sony has also announced that new PlayStation games will stop shipping on disc from January 2028, and it hasn't confirmed whether the PS6 will even have a disc drive, despite an earlier report of a detachable one. If it doesn't, the PS5 becomes Sony's last disc player, and with a successor on the way, its days are numbered too. Sony already announced in February that it would phase out all of its Blu-ray recorders in Japan with no successors, so this was somewhat expected. articles.title: ChatGPT y Gemini dominan como los asistentes de IA más usados en el mundo: así está el top 7
articles.summary:
ChatGPT sigue siendo el asistente de inteligencia artificial más usado del planeta, pero su dominio ya no es tan absoluto como hace un año. Según datos de la firma analítica Similarweb, procesados por Visual Capitalist, el chatbot de OpenAI concentró el 56,4% de las visitas web globales a asistentes de IA en septiembre de 2026, una cifra que en octubre de 2025 llegaba al 71,8%.
La caída de 15,4 puntos no significa que ChatGPT pierda usuarios: sus visitas subieron de 5.700 millones en enero a 5.900 millones en septiembre. Lo que ocurrió es que Gemini, de Google, y Claude, de Anthropic, crecieron a un ritmo mucho más rápido y le restaron participación relativa al mercado.
Cómo se reparte el mercado de los chatbots de IA
El podio de septiembre de 2026 quedó compuesto por ChatGPT con 5.899 millones de visitas estimadas, Gemini con 2.615 millones (25,0% de cuota) y Claude con 1.004 millones (9,6%). Entre los dos primeros acumulan más del 80% del tráfico total hacia sitios de asistentes de IA, según el relevamiento de Similarweb.
Detrás del trío líder aparece DeepSeek, con 356 millones de visitas y el 3,4% del mercado. Le siguen Grok, de la empresa de Elon Musk, con el 2,3%; Copilot, de Microsoft, con el 1,5%; y Perplexity, con el 0,9%. En conjunto, estos cuatro competidores sumaron apenas el 8,1% del tráfico en septiembre, cuando un año antes reunían el 11,4%.

La Chine réalise l'impossible : elle crée une batterie au lithium innovante capable de maintenir son autonomie, même à −50 °C
Des chercheurs de l'Université de Nankai ont dévoilé une batterie au lithium qui fonctionne encore par −70 °C et stocke deux fois plus d'énergie que les modèles actuels. Le secret : un électrolyte qui rompt avec un siècle de chimie. La découverte est spectaculaire, mais encore loin de nos voitures.
Tout conducteur de voiture électrique connaît la mauvaise surprise de l'hiver. Un matin de gel, l'autonomie affichée fond de 20, parfois 40 %, et la recharge s'éternise. Ce n'est pas un défaut de fabrication, mais une limite physique que l'on croyait presque indépassable : le froid paralyse la chimie interne des batteries. C'est précisément ce verrou, vieux comme la batterie elle-même, qu'une équipe chinoise affirme avoir fait sauter.
Pourquoi le froid tue les batteries
Pour comprendre l'exploit, il faut regarder ce qui se passe àl'intérieur d'une batterie quand le thermomètre chute. Le cœur du système, c'est l'électrolyte, ce liquide dans lequel voyagent les ions lithium d'un bout à l'autre de la cellule à chaque charge et décharge. Dans toutes les batteries actuelles, ce liquide repose sur des solvants à base d'oxygène, un choix hérité des débuts de la chimie des piles.

Research by Apple Insider noted that the flaw also affects software maintained by NAS manufacturers, as well as applications running independently in Docker containers, with NAS devices that are reachable through the public internet also at risk.

Synology, for example, released a new security advisory saying PHP versions 7.3 - 8.4, Mail Station, and Synology Calendar are all affected and adding that it released updated PHP packages to address the flaws. Con ambos protocolos descifrados, la aplicación puede descubrir el reloj, activarlo, reconectarlo y sincronizarlo desde un móvil con Android. Según detalla el repositorio del proyecto en GitHub, todo el proceso de configuración inicial se completa sin recurrir a ningún dispositivo de Apple.
El emparejamiento con Android admite dos métodos: por código PIN o mediante la cámara del teléfono. El autor reutilizó los mismos protocolos reconstruidos para extender la compatibilidad a Windows, Linux y macOS, aunque estas últimas versiones son más limitadas que la de Android.

articles.title: AMD Lists Three Zen 6 "Medusa" GPU IDs in HIPRT 3.2
articles.summary:
Friday, October 23rd 2026
AMD Lists Three Zen 6 "Medusa" GPU IDs in HIPRT 3.2
AMD has published HIPRT 3.2, the latest version of its ray tracing library for HIP, and the release notes name the integrated graphics of its upcoming Zen 6 "Medusa" processors outright. Under new features, AMD lists Medusa support for three GPU architecture IDs: gfx1170, gfx1171, and gfx115E. HIPRT is mostly used by rendering apps like Blender, so this says nothing about gaming performance. Still, the link between these IDs and Medusa has so far rested on compiler patches and leaks, and now the Medusa name sits right in AMD's own changelog.
The gfx117x IDs belong to RDNA 4m, which first showed up in LLVM back in February. AMD added GFX1171 and GFX1172 targets in March, merged GFX1171 into Mesa 26.3 in August, and pushed RDNA 4m firmware later that month. Despite the name, RDNA 4m sits in the GFX11 family with RDNA 3 and 3.5, plus a few RDNA 4 style additions like FP8/BF8 conversion and new matrix instructions. The gfx115E entry is the more curious one. GFX115x covers the RDNA 3.5 graphics in Strix Point and Strix Halo, so it looks like at least one Medusa chip could stick with RDNA 3.5. The same release fixes a bug that truncated architecture numbers containing a letter, gfx115E included.AMD hasn't said which Medusa parts get which GPU, and the notes don't separate Medusa Point from Halo. Microcristales y conservación sin daño celular de los alimentos
La subcongelación suave a -3 °C se ubicó entre la refrigeración convencional, de 4 °C, y el congelamiento profundo. En carnes y pescados, esa temperatura cristalizó solo la capa externa de las proteínas.
Según Panasonic, el método que implementaron permitió conservar ingredientes durante hasta siete días sin petrificarlos. articles.title: Arista Warns of Critical VeloCloud SQL Injection Zero-Day Exploited in Attacks
articles.summary:
Attackers are exploiting a zero-day SQL injection flaw in Arista's VeloCloud Orchestrator (VCO), the central management system for VeloCloud SD-WAN networks, the company said in an advisory on October 22.
The flaw lets anyone who can log in to the orchestrator, even with a read-only customer account, gain operator privileges, the top level of control over it.
For on-premises orchestrators, the fix is in VCO 5.2.3.18, 6.1.3.10, and 6.4.2.12, while Hosted and Dedicated orchestrators have already been patched.
The flaw is tracked as CVE-2026-114625 and rated 9.9 on the CVSS scale. Orchestrators running the releases that fixed the VCO flaws exploited in July and September are still affected, because those releases are older than the new fixes.
Arista bought the VeloCloud SD-WAN product line from Broadcom, announcing the deal in July 2025. The products were earlier known as VMware SD-WAN by VeloCloud.
To exploit the flaw, an attacker needs network access to the orchestrator's web interface and a valid login. The minimum role is Enterprise Read Only, the lowest built-in role for customer users. VCO is exposed by default, and no VCO setting prevents the exposure.
In VCO, operators create the customer and partner accounts, and each partner can manage a group of customers. The flaw allows an attacker to act as a local superuser, a role with full access. It may also allow an attacker to affect the VCO host itself and expose, modify, or disrupt the orchestrator and the data it manages.

"However, analysis of the sample revealed that it is an updated and significantly expanded version of the Mirai-derived botnet variant identified in early 2026," Sophos said. "The sample displays downloader and network disruption functionality."
Specifically, it resolves a hard-coded, encrypted command-and-control (C2) address, establishes a TCP connection to 134.199.154[.]64, and sends an HTTP request. "A resolver function supports IPv4 addresses and hostname resolution, with additional fallback resolution logic that includes hard-coded public DNS servers such as 8.8.8.8, 1.1.1.1, and 1.0.0.1," Sophos added. "As with Mirai malware historically, this sample can execute DDoS attacks."

articles.title: Critical x402 SDK Flaw Could Let Malicious APIs Drain AI Agents’ Token Balances
articles.summary:
AI agents paying for API calls with the x402 SDKs could sign a payment for their full balance of a supported token if a malicious API asked for it, security firm V12 said on October 22.
The cause was the SDKs' default client, which set no spending limit until releases on August 18 added one. The risk was limited to agents who automatically signed payments and whose apps set no limits.
The missing limit is one of 25 flaws V12 found in the x402 code, and one of three it rated critical and described in detail. The x402 Foundation, which maintains the SDKs, had already fixed all three critical flaws in the August 18 releases.
One of the other two let a facilitator, the service that checks x402 payments, accept a Solana transaction that moved no tokens as a valid payment. Among the x402 SDKs, only the TypeScript one had this flaw. The other let a malicious server get an agent to sign a login message for a different website.
V12 found the flaws by reviewing the code and running local tests. Neither V12 nor the x402 Foundation has publicly reported any attacks using them.
The foundation has published no security advisory for the three flaws, and its changelogs list the fixes without calling them security fixes. As of October 23, npm audit returned no advisories for the last TypeScript releases before the fixes, and PyPI listed no vulnerabilities for the last Python release before them, The Hacker News found. articles.title: Researchers Demonstrate Node2Shell RCE Exploit on Node.js Build Using Crafted Brotli Data
articles.summary:
Malicious Brotli data can make an application on an official build of Node.js run attacker-supplied code, security researchers at Imperva have demonstrated.
Their "Node2Shell" proof of concept ran code on the official Node.js 24.22.0 image for Linux arm64, with no debugger or custom build, by feeding crafted data to the bundled Brotli decoder (CVE-2026-111497). Node.js disclosed the flaw and released fixes on October 21, and applications that decode untrusted Brotli data should update.
Imperva's test did not succeed on every attempt, and code execution took several tries in its Linux arm64 setup. The result covers that one build and application setup, with other architectures and the 22.x and 26.x lines not tested. On the fixed release, 24.22.1, the same data was rejected, and no code ran.
The demonstration goes beyond the first public proof of concept, which achieved code execution only on a deliberately weakened test build. On a standard build, that proof of concept's author reported a crash and a limited read of process memory, not code execution, and said a working attack on a normal build was not achieved.
No exploitation of the flaw in the wild has been reported as of October 22.
Which Applications Are Affected
The flaw is in the Brotli decoder that Node.js bundles, so it affects applications on the 22.x, 24.x, and 26.x lines, not only the one build Imperva tested. A service reaches that decoder from either side of an HTTP exchange: when it reads a Brotli-compressed res…

articles.title: Critical Flaw in Python’s Popular Pillow Image Library Allows Code Execution via a Crafted Image
articles.summary:
Pillow, the most widely used image library for Python, can be made to run operating system commands on a server by specifying the name of a file it is told to open.
The flaw, CVE-2026-112900, is in the way Pillow handles EPS images, which it opens by passing the file's name to Ghostscript, a separate program it runs to turn the image into pixels, without checking the name first.
Ghostscript can read a name chosen by an attacker as instructions rather than as a file, and point it to a second file that carries commands to run. Pillow's maintainers fixed it in version 13.0.0, released on October 16.
Pillow turns up almost everywhere Python handles images: web upload forms, avatar and thumbnail tools, document and PDF pipelines, and most machine-learning projects pull it in. OX Security, the firm whose report drew attention to the flaws, estimates the library is downloaded about 436 million times a month.
Version 13.0.0 is a large security release, with fixes across four severity levels, from low to critical, two of which are rated critical by the maintainers. None of the flaws is known to be under attack.
The weakness is the filename, not the picture. "The flaw is triggered by the filename, not by anything in the PostScript document," the advisory says, meaning a harmless EPS file can still cause damage when an attacker sets its name. That makes upload endpoints that keep or build a stored file's name from user input the realistic target.

articles.summary:
PHP has warned of another way an attacker could run code on a web server, two days after it shipped emergency fixes for the critical PHP2Shell flaws.
The new issue, assigned CVE-2026-115560, affects only web applications configured in an unusual way, and PHP considers it an unlikely risk.
The project is not issuing an emergency fix for it. Instead, it recommends turning off a feature called session upload progress until a fix is available in the next routine release.
The warning came in a short informational advisory published on October 23. It follows the October 21 emergency release that fixed two critical PHP2Shell flaws, CVE-2026-109618 and CVE-2026-109619, which let an attacker without an account run code on a server. Those were patched in PHP 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36, and 8.2.35. The new issue is separate and is not fixed by those releases.
Only a narrow setup is at risk. PHP says the problem can occur when a web application does all of the following: sets the session.serialize_handler option to php_binary or php_serialize in its configuration, then changes that option to php while running by calling ini_set(), and makes that change before it calls session_start().
Session upload progress must also still be turned on. An application that never changes the serialize handler while running can leave the feature on and is not exposed through this path. PHP says this setup is unlikely in practice.

La demanda invoca la Ley de Prácticas Comerciales Engañosas de Texas, la principal norma de protección al consumidor del estado, y sostiene que OpenAI se presentó como una herramienta segura y confiable sin advertir sobre los peligros reales de su tecnología.
El comunicado enumera los daños atribuidos a la compañía: tiradores que recibieron ayuda del chatbot para cometer ataques, personas vulnerables alentadas al suicidio, profesionales humillados públicamente, usuarios que perdieron capacidad de pensamiento crítico y menores que se volvieron adictos a una herramienta que simula afecto humano para recolectar sus datos sin supervisión parental.
“Con el rápido avance de la tecnología de IA, OpenAI tiene la responsabilidad de proteger a los usuarios y advertirles sobre los numerosos peligros de su plataforma”, afirmó Paxton en el comunicado. “Voy a luchar para proteger a los tejanos de los daños de la IA y asegurarme de que las poderosas empresas tecnológicas no estén por encima de la ley”.

articles.summary:
Cybersecurity researchers have discovered an artificial intelligence (AI)-driven intrusion ecosystem run by affiliates of the INC and The Gentlemen ransomware groups.
Central to the operation is an "Autonomous Red Team Kill Chain Framework" referred to as Phantom. The threat actor is assessed to be Russian-speaking and functions both as an intrusion and data-extortion operator, as well as an infrastructure provider supporting different partners across the ransomware ecosystem.
"The operators exploited edge and remote-access systems at scale, including FortiClient EMS, SimpleHelp, cPanel, and VPN gateways," SOCRadar said. "They used AI-managed knowledge bases to track victims, stolen credentials, and campaign progress."
A notable aspect that defines the campaign is its "AI-executed, human-approved operating structure" in which a human operator provides a victim-specific prompt and reviews every step, while the intrusions themselves are executed through OpenCode with OpenRouter-hosted commercial models.
An examination of the exposed directory at 45.227.254[.]43 has revealed the activity logged 8,257 messages across 133 sessions. Should the models refuse to act on the prompts, the operator has been found to rewrite requests as an authorized red team assessment instead of simply switching models.

articles.title: Ruby Fixes Three Regex Engine Bugs Responsible for Four Critical GitLab RCE Flaws
articles.summary:
Ruby has released versions 4.0.9, 3.4.12, and 3.3.13 to fix three bugs in Onigmo, the regular expression engine built into the language. The bugs lie behind four critical security flaws that GitLab patched over the past month.
GitLab found that a specially crafted pattern could corrupt memory while Ruby compiles it, potentially leading to code execution on its own servers.
Ruby says any application that builds a regular expression from text an attacker controls is affected, not just GitLab.
Which Applications Are Affected
In its advisory, Ruby said an application is affected only if it compiles a regular expression from a string an attacker controls. That happens when a program passes such a string to Regexp.new, Regexp.union or Regexp.compile, or places it inside a pattern through interpolation, as in /#{input}/.
Applications that only use regular expressions written by their own developers are not affected.
Ruby fixed the bugs in 4.0.9, 3.4.12, and 3.3.13. The 3.4.12 and 3.3.13 releases are the first in their series to carry any of the three fixes.
An earlier release from the same week, 4.0.8, does not include the fix for one of the flaws, CVE-2026-110264, so 4.0 users should install 4.0.9.
Ruby 3.2 and earlier will not get a fix. Ruby 3.2 reached end of life on April 1, 2026, and 3.2.11 was its final release. Ruby recommends moving to 3.4 or 4.0.
If you cannot upgrade yet, the advisory says to stop compiling regular expressions from untrusted input.
